'''2007 Worlds Team David McCune LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David McCune]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif|label=You Can Either Profit By This...}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
